messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-gateway-prod -> error-rate > 8% (5xx). Auto-page to oncall-sre. PD incident: INC12345678. Priority: P1. Link: https://pd.redwood/INC12345678 (reaction: :rotating_light:)

oncall-sre: Acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it — looking at metrics and recent deploys.

incident-bot: Recent deploy: deploy-2026-03-14-03:12 UTC -> infra/runtime kernel-selection change rolled to 10% canary.

Jake L.: seeing big spike in 502s coming from backend pool gpu-pool-quantized-usw2. Sample logs:```
[2026-03-14T03:18:12Z] inference-gateway error 502 model=llm-q8a kernel_select=fastpath thread=42 msg="kv cache OOM?"
```

Maria H.: quick note — the canary touched the quantized kernel selector. Could be that the fastpath isn't handling short-seq warmups. If true, fallback to non-quantized should stop 502s (higher lat but safe).

oncall-sre: Confirming logs show `kernel_select=fastpath` before 502. Querying traces for a correlated change ID.

ops-bot: Autoscaler detected high error rate and attempted instance restart on 3 nodes in gpu-pool-quantized-usw2. Restart status: 2/3 success, 1/3 still restarting.

oncall-sre: Rolling traffic off gpu-pool-quantized-usw2 -> set routing policy to prefer gpu-pool-std-usw2. Command: `infra route set inference-gateway-prod --avoid gpu-pool-quantized-usw2 --reason "5xx spike"` (done).

Maria H.: Initiated model fallback for affected route: `model: llm-q8a@canary -> llm-q8a@stable` via console. This will increase p90 latency ~40ms but should stop errors.

Jake L.: curl test after routing change:`curl -i https://api.redwood/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -d '{"input":"hi"}'` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` (200ms). Previously returned 502 within 30s.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: "Traffic shifted from gpu-pool-quantized-usw2 to gpu-pool-std-usw2; model fallback applied. Monitoring for error rate."

Ashley (PM): Customer impact? Which tenants saw errors and what's the timeline? Need list for comms if >5% requests affected for >10m.

Lena (CS): I have live monitoring for top-20 tenants. So far 3 tenants (acct-101, acct-410, acct-502) saw >5% error rate between 03:15-03:20 UTC. All three are internal beta customers except acct-502 in prod — CS reaching out.

oncall-sre: Current metrics: error-rate dropped from 9.4% -> 0.6% over 6 minutes after routing + fallback. Latency p95 increased 35ms. No evidence of degraded downstream services.

Maria H.: Root hypothesis: new fastpath kernel selector doesn't handle a race with very short-prefix KV cache hits; it returns a malformed proto leading to 502. Plan: revert canary, add extra validation in selector, add e2e test for short-prefix cases.

Jake L.: I'll open a quick revert PR for the kernel selector canary and tag infra/ci to block canary re-roll until tests added.

ops-bot: Node that was slow to restart has recovered. Pool health: gpu-pool-quantized-usw2 = degraded (some nodes still cycling).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345678 auto-escalated to infra-eng-svc-owner due to P1 rules.

Ashley (PM): Good containment. CS: please prep a short customer note for acct-502 — include timeline, mitigation, and next steps. Ops/Eng: keep me posted once revert PR is merged.

Lena (CS): On it — pinging acct-502 contact now. Will update status page if they request.

oncall-sre: Follow-ups: (1) confirm revert PR and link, (2) schedule postmortem if incident >30m or customer impact >1 tenant prod (we have both conditions maybe). Current elapsed ~12m.

Maria H.: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/r/4321 revert canary. Adding test plan in PR body.

Jake L.: Merging revert now. Will monitor metrics after merge.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rolling revert release started -> canary 100% removed.

oncall-sre: Metrics look stable. Error rate holding <1% for 8m. Keeping channel open for 30 more minutes to confirm.

Ashley (PM): Thanks team. After 30m if stable, I'll draft post-incident summary for internal ops and a customer note variant.

Lena (CS): Confirmed acct-502 acknowledged our outreach and will wait for postmortem.

oncall-sre: Closing actions added to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-spike (section: kernel-selectors). Will assign to Maria and Jake for follow-up.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345678 -> status: acknowledged -> resolved (resolved by oncall-sre at 03:40 UTC). (reaction: :white_check_mark:)

oncall-sre: Marking this thread resolved in Slack. Filing incident in incidents tracker with timeline and mitigation steps.

Maria H.: Postmortem will include RCA, timeline, and test additions. Will share draft in #postmortems tomorrow.

Jake L.: Thanks all — will also add a canary rollback smoke test to CI.

Ashley (PM): Good work.
